lines.text: A real-life criminal demanded ten million dollars from Rockstar Games -
claiming they stole his face for the GTA Six trailer!
When the GTA Six trailer dropped, it broke world records with over ninety million views in a single day.
One viral scene showed a tattooed criminal with purple hair in a courtroom.
The internet instantly recognized him as Lawrence Sullivan,
the famous Florida Joker whose mugshot went viral across social media in twenty seventeen.
Sullivan posted a video on TikTok shouting: "GTA, we need to talk! You took my likeness, give me a million dollars!"
A week later, he raised his demand to two million.
Then five million. And finally, ten million dollars, threatening to team up with the GTA hackers!
Years ago, actress Lindsay Lohan sued Rockstar for copying her in GTA Five,
and New York courts ruled that video game parody is protected by the First Amendment.
The Florida Joker got zero dollars.
